name: Starship Andromeda
storyline: The entire galaxy is controlled by a federation led by a tyrant called Alana who alone has access to a Mind-Lord computer that controls everything. The computer key is a crystal suspended from a necklace of Pentite which is one of the hardest elements known in the Galaxy and only a proton spear powered by Zyron and Trysst can cut it. You have been tasked with pursuing Alana and retrieving the crystal in your spaceship called Andromeda, but Alana is moving around the galaxy all the time, so her exact location is rarely known. You must scour the entire galaxy for starbases to take over to restrict Alana's movements and scan planets to find the spear and the elements that power it.
